description: This Java interface defines a remote dispatcher for executing services via RMI in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled service execution with various options such as timeouts, persistence, and result handling.

classes.name: RemoteDispatcher
classes.description: A Java interface for remote invocation of service execution operations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Execute a service synchronously with or without a timeout and transaction control, returning the result map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Execute a service synchronously and ignore the result (fire-and-forget).

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Execute a service asynchronously, with options for persistence, timeouts, and requester callback.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Execute a service asynchronously and obtain a waiter object to monitor or retrieve the result.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedule a service to run at a specific start time with recurrence settings.
